sources.title: Predicting the Price of Bitcoin Using Sentiment-Enriched Time ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: More precisely, we propose a hybrid approach, combining time series forecasting and sentiment prediction from microblogs, to predict the intraday price of Bitcoin. Moreover, in addition to standard sentiment analysis methods, we are the first to employ a fine-tuned BERT model for this task.
